note: Block risk estimate (spec 8.8): a transparent heuristic, not a trained model. risk = sum(weight * factor), clamped 0..1. Weather is only modelled for LSD and HS; other diseases get the neutral 0.5 and say so. Vaccines per disease come from vaccines.json. 'diseases' is the order the officer sees them in; the first is shown by default.

lsd.why: warm, humid days with some rain help the flies and mosquitoes that spread LSD

hs.why: heavy rain and high humidity favour HS (galghotu)
